headerDisplay: Control Samsung air conditioners from the Home app, Siri and your HomePod. Connect to SmartThings above, then pick which extras to show.

pollInterval.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often Paperclip reads the AC from SmartThings. Changes you make in HomeKit are sent immediately either way.

fanTile.title: Fan control (speed, Auto, Oscillate)
fanTile.description: Shown inside the AC tile with Low, Medium, High and Turbo, an Auto toggle and Oscillate. Turning the Fan on while the AC is off runs fan-only mode.

optionalModeSwitches.title: Samsung modes to show as switches
optionalModeSwitches.description: Shown under the AC's dial, like the Samsung app. Only modes your AC supports appear. Turbo only turns on while the AC is cooling, and none of them turn on while it's off.

dryModeSwitch.title: Dry (dehumidify) switch
dryModeSwitch.description: Apple's mode menu only has Off, Cool, Auto and Heat, so Dry is a toggle under the dial. While it's on, the menu shows Cool. Turning it off returns to the previous mode.

fanModeSwitch.title: Fan Only switch
fanModeSwitch.description: Usually not needed: turning the Fan on while the AC is off already runs fan-only.

humiditySensor.title: Humidity sensor
humiditySensor.description: Shows the room humidity your AC measures (if it has a sensor).

displaySwitch.title: Display light switch
displaySwitch.description: Turns the indoor unit's temperature display on or off. Shown inside the AC's tile.

autoCleanSwitch.title: Auto Clean switch
autoCleanSwitch.description: Shown inside the AC's tile. Most people set this once in the Samsung app instead.

beepSwitch.title: Beep switch
beepSwitch.description: Turns the beep on the indoor unit on or off.

filterStatus.title: Filter life
filterStatus.description: Shows how much filter life is left and alerts you when it needs cleaning.

swingMode.title: Swing direction when you turn swing on

swingDirectionSwitches.title: Swing Up/Down and Swing Left/Right switches
swingDirectionSwitches.description: Separate up/down and left/right switches inside the AC's tile. The Fan's Oscillate toggle uses the direction chosen above.

excludeDevices.title: Hide these air conditioners
excludeDevices.description: Names or SmartThings device IDs (shown in the Homebridge log) to leave out of HomeKit.

removeStaleAccessories.title: Remove ACs that are deleted from SmartThings

clientId.title: OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: Only for manual setups. The settings page above normally stores this for you.

refreshToken.title: OAuth Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Used once; after that Paperclip keeps the rotated token in its own file.

accessToken.title: Personal access token (testing only)
accessToken.description: SmartThings tokens stop working 24 hours after you create them. Use the setup above instead.

layout.title: HomeKit extras
layout.description: Everything here only appears if your AC supports it.
